jobs.title: Sr. Analyst, Product Project Management (PET)
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.​

Job Overview
The GIC Supply Chain team manages planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and analytics to meet market needs, optimize operations, and enable the efficient movement of goods from production to delivery.
Purpose of the Role
The Senior Analyst, Product Project Management ensures the availability and effective management of ingredients and packaging materials for US-based product and business initiatives. Responsibilities include planning-system setup, risk and waste assessment, mitigation, and project execution.
Partners with Project Planning, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Materials Management, PMO, Marketing, Sales, R&D, Sourcing, and Manufacturing teams.

Key Accountabilities
100% of Time
Product Setup & Commercialization Governance
- Lead material setup and lifecycle execution through Gate 2, including new items, packaging codes, extensions, and deactivations in SAP and PLM.
- Ensure master-data accuracy and governance compliance while resolving workflow and system issues with technical and master-data teams.
- Support mergers, acquisitions, migrations, and commercialization initiatives; serve as SME for SAP, Evolve, PLM, and ServiceNow.

Raw Material Lifecycle & Write-Off Management
- Drive lifecycle strategy, RMWO forecasting, reconciliation, and risk mitigation to minimize write-offs and inventory exposure.
- Lead packaging/vendor transitions, material changeovers, and DISCO tie-out and drawdown plans to reduce obsolescence.
- Partner with Sourcing, Business Operations, and plants on quantities, disposition orders, inventory levels, safety stocks, and operational continuity.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management
- Serve as the primary liaison among Commercialization, Sourcing, Business Operations, plants, and Technical teams.
- Provide risk visibility and mitigation recommendations, track milestones, and highlight impacts to launch timelines and financial exposure.
- Communicate metrics and lifecycle health while managing material setup, packaging-transition, and lifecycle-risk escalations.

Reporting, Controls & Continuous Improvement
- Maintain dashboards for commercialization cycle times, data accuracy, RMWO performance, and project metrics.
- Improve lifecycle and data-governance processes through automation, standardization, and CI tools such as Why-Why, FMEA, Fishbone, and BPIM.
- Develop SOPs and governance standards while identifying cost-saving opportunities across the inbound and raw-material network.

Business Impact & Financial Stewardship
- Manage raw-material budgets and support financial forecasting by reconciling projections with actuals.
- Reduce write-offs through proactive lifecycle planning and risk mitigation.

Education – Full-time graduation from an accredited university (mandatory; this criterion cannot be altered).
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.
• Minimum 4 years of relevant experience.
Specific Job Experience or Skills Needed
• Knowledge of Supply Chain, inventory management, total landed cost, and project management.
• Analytical, mathematical, statistical, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights.
• Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, charts/graphs, macros, Solver, queries, and mathematical functions.
• Experience with SAP MM or other ERP systems.
• Ability to prioritize, multitask, meet tight deadlines, and navigate ambiguity.
• Continuous-improvement mindset with the ability to coach others and influence.
• Proactive, solution-oriented approach with sound decision-making ability.
• Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
Competencies/Behaviors Required for the Job
Workplace and Leadership Competencies
Problem solving and decision making; teamwork and collaboration; accountability; customer focus; planning and organizing; enabling technology; innovation.
Academic Competencies
Math, statistics, and analytical thinking; applied science and technology; Supply Chain fundamentals; reading and writing; business management fundamentals.
Personal Effectiveness Competencies
Integrity; continuous learning; communication; interpersonal skills; creativity.

ELIGIBILITY
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.​

OVERVIEW
The Product Owner – Knowledge Management is responsible for the strategic oversight and advancement of the supply chain capabilities that enable our digital transformation. They will lead design, testing and implementation with Supply Chain teams and leverage close partnership with D&T, Finance, and 3rd parties. The role will also work across Supply Chain pillar teams and current transformation efforts to coordinate capability development and knowledge advancement. Focus areas include integration of ai capabilities, visibility tools, automation & workflow tools, smart alerts, advanced analytics and support for key initiatives. This position reports to the Sr. Manager Digital Foundations
The Product Owner – Knowledge Management plays a central role in the continued evolution of our SC Digital Literacy and Learning model by optimizing performance and identifying opportunities for value creation, while expanding the scope to our Finance, teams and SC Governance workstreams. The shift timings for the role will be 1:30 PM–10:30 PM
Function Overview
The GIC Supply Chain team manages end-to-end operations, encompassing planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and analytics. They strategically plan to meet market demands, optimize sourcing, ensure efficient production, and oversee the seamless movement of goods from production to delivery. The team employs advanced analytics throughout these processes, fostering adaptability and operational excellence. This collaborative approach ensures a well-coordinated supply chain that aligns with both organizational goals and dynamic market conditions.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
- Develop strategic roadmap for Supply Chain Digital Capabilities to include design and implementation across platforms
- Coordination across transformation efforts.
- Develop capabilities to support Supply Chain Pillars and Segments (including ESC and Finance)
- Manage third party vendor relationships and contracts
- Prioritize capability build and implementation which includes External Benchmarking, training and documentation creation
- Exploration and testing of advanced technologies for Supply Chain application (Artificial Intelligence, Smart Alerts, Automation)

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
·       Bachelor's/master’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain.
·       12+ years of related experience in Supply chain, Business and Digital transformation projects, Product ownership
·       Proven project management skills
·       Experience working with third parties and global partners
·       Supply Chain knowledge with experience partnering with D&T organization
·       Successful change management background

Skills & Abilities:
·       Proven project management skills
·       Experience working with third parties and global partners.
·       Strong leadership skills, including the ability to drive change
·       Strong influence skills and ability to influence across functions and business strategies
·       Excellent communication and collaboration skills
·       Strong organizational and people development skills
·       Able to lead and direct cross functional team members
·       Self-managing, results oriented and capable of leading multiple initiatives simultaneously
·       Able to enter uncertain/ambiguous situations, assess opportunities, identify stakeholders, and bring direction to a project, take action, and deliver results
·       Strong analytical thinking and creative problem solving
·       Ability to work in global multi-cultural teams (global organizations/MNCs)
·       Demonstrated high level of learning & cultural agility.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Preferred Degree Requirements: Masters
- Preferred Major Area of Study: Operations Supply Chain
- Preferred Professional Certifications: CPIM/CSCP
- Preferred years of related experience: 1-2 years

Development Candidate Will Receive in Role
- End-to-End Supply Chain experience
- Vendor management and contract management
- Finance – budget creation and oversight
- Leading a Global Digital program
- Executive Communication – partnering with SC Pillar Leaders
- Service management mindset & capabilities

ELIGIBILITY
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

jobs.title: Associate Principal Product Guidance Scientist - Pet
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.​

JOB OVERVIEW:
The Associate Principal Product Guidance & Insights Scientist will lead Product Guidance & Insights (PGI) for the Pet business, with a primary focus on companion animal research to inform the development of feeding and treating products.

This role translates deep sensory, product, and pet parent understanding into clear guidance that helps teams design and deliver remarkable product experiences across innovation, core renovation, quality, and value optimization. This role will shape learning strategies, generate actionable recommendations for product and packaging, and help cross-functional teams make smarter data-based decisions.

This individual will also build PGI capability through direct people leadership, strong prioritization, and the introduction of modern methods and tools.

WHAT DOES A SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE LOOK LIKE:
The strongest candidates for this role combine deep sensory science expertise, strong dog and cat feeding and treating category knowledge, and the ability to translate complex learning into clear business action.

They are credible technical leaders who can identify the most important questions, design efficient learning plans with the right rigor, and turn insights into practical guidance that improves product experience, preference, and business performance.

They can influence effectively across all functions and levels within the organization, lead and develop talent, and continuously raise the impact of PGI through strong technical expertise, modern methods, and thoughtful use of new tools and technologies.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:
- Lead Sensory and Product Guidance strategy and execution for the Pet business with a focus on companion animal research (for dogs and cats)

- Lead and develop one direct report, including coaching, work prioritization, development planning, and performance management.

- Partner on cross-functional project teams to define the most important product and pet parent questions, build effective learning plans to answer them, and de-risk critical business decisions.

- Design and lead sensory guidance, pet parent product understanding, descriptive, discrimination, and confirmatory learning plans from early exploration through iterative product optimization and validation.

- Generate actionable insights and recommendations by integrating sensory data, product knowledge, technical understanding, and business context.

- Influence product design, optimization, and troubleshooting decisions by helping teams understand the sensory and experiential drivers of product performance and preference.

- Communicate findings clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical stakeholders, tailoring recommendations to drive alignment and action.

- Partner closely with the Pet Technology Team to ensure holistic product guidance from both pet and pet parent perspectives.

- Build foundational knowledge of key pet feeding and treating product spaces, including relevant product forms, formats, textures, aromas, palatability-related cues, and usage occasions.

- Build and strengthen external partnerships to strengthen foundational knowledge in pet feeding and treating.

- Champion the product and pet parent voice to ensure products deliver on the intended experience, functionality, and preference.

- Prioritize projects against available resources and business needs, ensuring the highest-value work is resourced and executed with excellence.

- Identify capability gaps and bring forward new tools, methods, and ways of working to improve the speed, quality, and impact of PGI learning.

- Contribute to a strong team culture by modeling collaboration, curiosity, technical rigor, and a continuous learning mindset.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:
- Master's degree or PhD in Sensory Science, Behavioral Science, Psychology, Animal Science, Consumer Science, or related field.

- 7+ years of relevant pet experience in sensory science, consumer product research, product guidance, or related technical roles.

- Experience applying sensory science to product development, optimization, quality, and pet parent guidance within complex product systems.

- Experience developing and executing robust learning plans with appropriate rigor to risk in partnership with cross-functional business and technical teams.

- Strong understanding of experimental design, statistical analysis, and interpretation of sensory and consumer data.

- Proven ability to connect technical product knowledge with consumer or user experience to inform product design decisions.

- Strong interpersonal, communication, collaboration, and influence skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a matrixed organization.

- Demonstrated passion for leading and developing people.

- Strong learning agility, problem-solving capability, experimentation mindset, and comfort with ambiguity.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
- Experience leading people as a manager of people or in a strong technical leadership role.

- Experience building foundational product knowledge and translating it into practical guidance for teams.

- Experience working across multiple brands, platforms, or business segments.

- Ability to identify and introduce new capabilities, tools, or analytic approaches that improve learning impact and efficiency.

- Demonstrated business acumen and ability to influence strategy and direction through product and pet parent insight.

ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATIONS:
- International relocation or international remote working arrangements (outside of the US) will not be considered.

- Applicants for this position must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. General Mills will not sponsor applicants for this position for work visas.

SALARY RANGE
The salary range for this position is:
$110,800 - $166,300 Annual

At General Mills we strive for each employee's pay at any point in their career to reflect their experiences performance and skills for their current role. The salary range for this role represents the numerous factors considered in the hiring decisions including, but not limited to, educations, skills, work experience, certifications, etc. As such, pay for the successful candidate(s) could fall anywhere within the stated range. ​
​
Beyond base salary, General Mills offers a competitive Total Rewards package focusing on your overall well-being. We are proud to offer a foundation of health benefits, retirement and financial wellbeing, time off programs, wellbeing support and perks. Benefits may vary by role, country, region, union status, and other employment status factors. You may also be eligible to participate in an annual incentive program. An incentive award, if any, depends on various factors, including, individual and organizational performance.

ELIGIBILITY
Applicants must meet a minimum 18-year age qualification.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER (EOE) ​

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital or familial status, status regarding public assistance, or membership or activity in a local human rights commission.
